name: keep-sorted
description: VS Code extension to automatically keep code blocks sorted

commands.title: Keep Sorted: Sort All Files with Problems
Keep Sorted: Add AI Instructions to Workspace

languageModelTools.name: keepSorted_getGuide
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read Keep Sorted guidance for wrapping, options, and verification.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns guidance on keeping code sorted with keep-sorted blocks, matching the installed extension. Call it before adding keep-sorted markers or choosing options: start with 'overview', and always read 'when-not-to-wrap' before wrapping, since sorting order-dependent code (middleware, precedence lists, CSS rules, positional arguments) changes behavior. Topics: overview (workflow and common mistakes), when-not-to-wrap, choosing-options (options by content type, including functions and class members), markers-and-languages (comment syntax), preferences, verification, options (every option and its values). Not needed for sorting blocks that already exist; use keepSorted_run.

topic.description: The guide to read. Start with 'overview'.

languageModelTools.name: keepSorted_getPreferences
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read your default keep-sorted options for new blocks.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the user's preferred keep-sorted options for new blocks (the keep-sorted.wrap.preferences setting). Pass a file to also get the options resolved for that file, with the setting layer each came from. Call it before choosing options for a new block. keepSorted_wrapRange applies these preferences itself, so call this to plan or explain options, not before every wrap. Existing blocks keep their own options.

uri.description: The file: a file URI, an absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace root. Optional.

languageModelTools.name: keepSorted_wrapRange
languageModelTools.userDescription: Wrap lines in keep-sorted markers so they stay sorted.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Inserts keep-sorted start and end markers around whole lines, using the file language's comment syntax and indentation, with the user's preferred options plus any you pass. It does not sort; call keepSorted_run afterwards and check the diff. Use it only for order-independent content: read the 'when-not-to-wrap' guide first, and for multi-line items such as functions or class members read 'choosing-options' for the options they need. Fails with an explanation for files without comments (JSON), ranges that partly overlap an existing block, files with unpaired markers, and invalid options, listing the valid values. Lines are 1-based and inclusive; read the file first for exact numbers.

uri.description: The file: a file URI, an absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace root.

startLine.description: First line to wrap, 1-based. The start marker goes above it.

endLine.description: Last line to wrap, 1-based and inclusive. The end marker goes below it.

options.description: keep-sorted options for the start line, written as on the start line, e.g. {"numeric": "yes"}. They override preferences. Read the 'options' guide for values.

skip_lines.description: Lines to ignore before sorting; a negative value skips lines at the end of the block

group.description: Group lines together based on increasing indentation

group_prefixes.description: Prefixes of lines that should be added to the preceding group

block.description: Enable block mode to understand multi-line code blocks

sticky_comments.description: Attach comments to the line immediately below them while sorting

sticky_prefixes.description: Prefixes of lines that should behave as sticky comments

group_start_regex.description: Regexes that match the first line of a group; other lines join the previous group

group_end_regex.description: Regexes that match the last line of a group; non-comment lines no longer end groups

order.description: Sort in ascending or descending order

numeric.description: Sort numbers by their numeric value instead of lexically

prefix_order.description: Explicitly order lines by matching prefix; an empty item positions unmatched lines

ignore_prefixes.description: Prefixes to ignore when sorting lines

newline_separated.description: Separate sorted groups with newlines (yes/no or number of newlines)

remove_duplicates.description: Remove duplicate lines; keep_first_comment and merge_comments compare code only and keep or merge their comments

allow_yaml_lists.description: Allow list-valued options to be specified using YAML syntax

usePreferences.description: Apply the user's wrap preferences. Defaults to true.

languageModelTools.name: keepSorted_run
languageModelTools.userDescription: Sort keep-sorted blocks in a file or the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sorts keep-sorted blocks and returns the diagnostics that remain, such as unpaired markers or invalid options. Use scope 'file' with a uri after wrapping or editing a block; use 'workspace' only when the user asks to sort everything. Only lines between markers move. After it runs, compare the file with its previous state: each item should move whole, with its comments and decorators.

scope.description: 'file' sorts one file; 'workspace' sorts every file with unsorted blocks.

uri.description: The file: a file URI, an absolute path, or a path relative to the workspace root. Required for scope 'file'.

keep-sorted.enabled.markdownDescription: Enable Keep Sorted diagnostics, sorting commands, and code actions. To sort on save, configure `#editor.codeActionsOnSave#` with `"source.fixAll.keepSorted": "explicit"` (manual saves) or `"always"` (also focus/window-change Auto Save, not after-delay Auto Save). `#editor.formatOnSave#` alone does not enable sorting.

keep-sorted.autoComplete.markdownDescription: Suggest keep-sorted option names and values, with documentation tooltips, after `start` on a keep-sorted block's start line.

keep-sorted.exclude.markdownDescription: Exclude files from diagnostics and sorting. Patterns are interpreted as regular expressions first, with glob matching used when a pattern is not a valid regex. Each pattern is checked against the workspace-relative path, absolute path, and file name.

keep-sorted.logFilepath.markdownDescription: Write extension logs to a file in addition to the Keep Sorted Output channel. Empty disables file logging. Paths are joined to the first workspace folder when one is open; without a workspace, the configured path is used directly. Use a workspace-relative path such as `logs/keep-sorted.log`.

keep-sorted.wrap.preferences.markdownDescription: Default options that AI agents apply when they wrap lines in a new keep-sorted block, through the Keep Sorted language model tools or MCP server. Layers apply in order: `options`, then `languages` by language ID, then each matching `files` glob, then options the agent passes explicitly. Values are written as on a start line, such as `"yes"` or `"1,-1"`; `null` removes an earlier value. Existing blocks and sorting are not affected.
